settings.content: Used only when Theme style = Custom. Fonts come from the Typography panel; corner radius from Buttons and "Base theme".

One dropdown for the whole store: it sets the home page and the default product page. IMPORTANT: a product only follows this if it stays on the DEFAULT product template — assigning a product the landing / multi-style / multi-product template opts it out.
Sections not used by the chosen type stay listed below but are hidden on the storefront. Each section's "Show on store type" controls this.
Tip: this store is themed by Theme settings → Theme style (and Custom style). These raw color schemes are only used when Theme style = Custom.

settings.content: "Spend/buy more, save more" progress bar in the cart drawer. Each tier MUST match an Automatic discount in Admin → Discounts (same minimum), or the bar promises a discount checkout won't apply. Run bootstrap-store.mjs with BOOTSTRAP_QTY_DISCOUNTS=1 to create the matching discounts. (Thanh tiến trình cart: mỗi mốc phải khớp Automatic discount trong Admin.)
